summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to disclose that CEO Omar Abbosh has been appointed as a Non-Executive Director to the board of Autodesk, Inc., effective 17 June 2026. The filing is a director declaration under UKLR 6.4.9R, a UK listing rule. No terms, stake, or consideration are stated as this is a personal board appointment, not a transaction. The disclosure serves to notify the market of the CEO's external directorship. As an ordinary current report of a foreign private issuer, this is classified as a management change. What to watch: potential time allocation or conflict-of-interest concerns.
